name: hysterectomy overview
title: Hysterectomy routes from least to most invasive: the vaginal route and laparoscopic-assisted vaginal hysterectomy when the anatomy allows, total laparoscopic or robotic hysterectomy in place of the abdominal route, and abdominal hysterectomy as the last resort; each column gives who the route suits and its limits, with the types of hysterectomy named by what comes out

root.title: Hysterectomy: choose the LEAST invasive route the anatomy allows
lines: for bleeding: medical options FIRST; hysterectomy after failed medical management or in special circumstances
every route but abdominal is minimally invasive: a short stay, same-day discharge

groups.title: 1st: the VAGINAL route, if the anatomy allows
lines: the uterus comes out through the vagina

groups.title: 2nd: LAPAROSCOPIC, in place of abdominal
lines: should NOT replace vaginal or LAVH

groups.title: LAST: ABDOMINAL
lines: when no minimally invasive route will do

head: h
Vaginal hysterectomy
NO abdominal incisions: the least invasive
suits: whenever the anatomy allows a vaginal approach
lim: large uterus · narrow introitus or pelvis · poor uterine descent

head: h
Laparoscopic-assisted vaginal hysterectomy (LAVH)
enters the abdomen; uterus out via the vagina
suits: assess the pelvis, scarring · bladder flap
remove tubes, ovaries · a 'second look' for hemostasis
lim: large uterus · narrow introitus or pelvis · poor uterine descent

head: h
Total laparoscopic hysterectomy (TLH)
total or subtotal · enters the abdomen
lim: takes skill and more operative time

head: h
Robotic-assisted hysterectomy
enters the abdomen
lim: articulating instruments make it more manageable
takes skill and more operative time

head: h
Abdominal hysterectomy
open: NOT minimally invasive
suits: VERY LARGE uterus · more complex cancers
patient factors unsuited to the other routes
lim: the only route without same-day discharge

panels.title: Named by what comes out
items: 'Partial' (lay term): ovaries kept, so NO surgical menopause
